I could not check any verb names against the page, so these queries use guessed verbs (`filter`, `sortBy`, `groupBy`, `lower`, `split` and so on) that may not exist. I wrote them in the pipeline form the page describes. I used `J` labels to match the task names, although the instruction mentions `H1`.

J1: `/data | filter (/active | eq true | and (/address/city | isString)) | sortBy (/name | lower) * /name`
J2: `filter (/status | lower | eq "paid") * (/items * (/qty | mul /price) | sum) | sum | round 2`
J3: `[/dependencies /devDependencies] | merge | entries | filter (/1 | startsWith "^") | sortBy /0 * (/0 | add "@" | add /1)`
J4: `filter (/state | eq "open") * (/assignee/login | default "unassigned") | countBy`
J5: `:d /defaults | /services | filter (/enabled | ne false) * {:name /name :timeout (/timeout | default (d | /timeout)) :retries (/retries | default (d | /retries))} | sortBy /name`
J6: `filter (/durationMs | isNumber) | groupBy /service * (* /durationMs | avg | round 1)`
J7: `filter (/stock | isNumber | and (/stock | gt 0)) | sortBy /price | reverse | take 3 * /name`
J8: `groupBy /dept * (* (/skills | default []) | flatten * lower | distinct | sort)`
J9: `filter (/role | lower | eq "db") | all (/region | eq "eu-west" | and (/cpu/cores | gte 8))`
J10: `"Alice@Example.com, bob@test.org; carol@EXAMPLE.com, dave@mail.net; erin@Test.org, frank@example.com" | split #"[,;] ?" * (split "@" | /1 | lower) | distinct | sort`
J11: `lines * split " " | filter (/3 | toNumber | gte 500) | countBy /2 | entries * {:path /0 :count /1} | sortBy [(/count | neg) /path] | take 2`
J12: `lines | drop 1 * split "," | filter (/2 | ne "") | groupBy /1 * (* (/2 | toNumber) | avg | round 2)`
J13: `lines | filter (contains "==" | and (startsWith "#" | not)) * split "==" | map {(/0 | lower) /1}`
J14: `sortBy (/comments | default [] * (/likes | default 0) | sum) | last | /title`
